# Support

Start with the [README](../README.md) for installation, usage, and API behavior.
Check the [live verification report](../docs/live-verification.md) for known
differences between the API documentation and observed responses.

Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/2chevskii/go-hexcore/discussions) for
questions, troubleshooting, and early ideas. Use the issue templates for
reproducible client bugs, documentation corrections, and focused feature requests.
Follow [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for confidential vulnerability reports.

For account access, billing, and hosting resource problems, contact
[HexCore](https://hexcore.ru/). Include only sanitized examples when discussing
API behavior here.
